title: Clo User Summit 2024: New York City 🚖
description:
Watch the highlights from our 🗽 2024 CLO NY User Summit 🍎! Thanks to all our speakers, partners, staff & most of all, our attendees - many of whom traveled a long way to be with us! We hope this year's Summit inspired you to continue to invest in each other as we look forward to weaving the future of fashion, together with you. Comment below if you spot yourself in the video!

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/7814962429977-How-can-I-join-CLO-Discord-

transcript: The reason we are having this user summit today is we want to bring enterprise clients as well as individual users or just overall general users that loves Clo, that utilizes Clo. We want to bring them all together so they can see what we have in our rolemask. We want them to utilize Clo in a way that they might never did it before. My highlight from this event was meeting other people in different companies but in the same industry and sharing experiences. Main takeaway from this event is this incredible collaboration amongst all the companies that are using Clo and the incredible future possibilities with what 3D and Clo can do for the industry. So we're just excited to be here and be surrounded by so many incredible people who are nerdy in the same ways that we are.
